changelog:
First stable release.

New in 0.1.0:
- Android TV: bold gecko-green focus ring makes the D-pad cursor obvious across interactive elements
- Android TV: global media-key support (play / pause / next / prev / stop from anywhere)
- Android TV: 'Now Playing' rail shortcut + structural focus containment while the player is open
- Android TV: branded launcher banner (gecko + BuddyGecko wordmark)
- Android TV: tab scroll state preserved across player/detail round-trips
- Bugfix: search-field focus tick no longer re-fires the keyboard after screen remount
